project_scope.example_name: Color-changing LED with Arduino Uno R3
project_scope.supported_v1_project: One red LED in series with one current-limiting resistor, powered by a positive DC source and ground.
project_scope.board_scope_note: The board name is accepted for the first planning example only. This reference does not establish any Uno R3 electrical capability or circuit compatibility.

components.name: DC voltage source
components.purpose: Provide the positive supply for the series circuit

simulator.supported_measurement: Simulated current through the modeled red LED circuit

unknown.subject: Arduino Uno R3 pin current limits
unknown.why_it_matters: A pin limit is needed before making claims about current supplied by a board pin.
unknown.planner_action: Ask for a verified source or label Needs confirmation; do not assign a pin or claim pin compatibility.

unknown.subject: Arduino Uno R3 5 V regulator rating
unknown.why_it_matters: The board's ability to provide a planned load cannot be inferred from the 5 V circuit simulation.
unknown.planner_action: Label Needs confirmation; do not claim that the board can supply the circuit current.

unknown.subject: Uno R3 USB versus external supply behavior and limits
unknown.why_it_matters: The supply path may change the applicable limits and is outside the verified 5 V simulator example.
unknown.planner_action: Ask which supply is intended if it affects the plan; otherwise label Needs confirmation and do not give USB or external-supply advice.

unknown.subject: Recommended Arduino Uno R3 pins for this project
unknown.why_it_matters: Pin mapping has not been verified and the simulator does not model Arduino pin behavior.
unknown.planner_action: Do not provide pin numbers; label Needs confirmation if the user asks.

unknown.subject: Driving an LED directly without a series resistor
unknown.why_it_matters: The supported circuit requires a current-limiting resistor; direct-drive behavior and board limits are not verified.
unknown.planner_action: Do not recommend direct drive. State that the series resistor is required in this scope.

unknown.subject: User's physical LED part number and actual forward voltage
unknown.why_it_matters: The reference's 2.0 V is a model value and may not describe the user's specific LED.
unknown.planner_action: Label Needs confirmation; do not present the model value as the measured value of the user's part.

unknown.subject: Series resistor wattage rating
unknown.why_it_matters: No resistor power rating has been verified for the user's physical part.
unknown.planner_action: Label Needs confirmation; do not claim a resistor is physically suitable without its rating.

unknown.subject: Exact resistor value for the user's actual supply and LED
unknown.why_it_matters: The correct value depends on confirmed supply voltage and the actual LED forward voltage; 220 Ω and 330 Ω are only values exercised in the 5 V demo.
unknown.planner_action: Ask for the supply and LED details or label Needs confirmation; do not treat a demo value as universally correct.

unknown.subject: Whether the Uno R3 5 V pin can supply the planned current
unknown.why_it_matters: No Uno R3 supply-pin rating is established by the circuit simulation.
unknown.planner_action: Label Needs confirmation and do not claim the Uno 5 V pin can power the load.
